comment: Per-directory deletion rules for archive_rotate.py --retention (see docs/research_lab/data_catalogue/RETENTION.md). A server file is only ever removed if it is in a verified release with an identical sha256; these rules only say how old it must be and which small files stay. Directories without a rule are never deleted. GATE: snapshots/ and book_sweeps/ have NO rule until queue jobs q0005, q0006a, q0006 (leadlag_screen, bounce_decomp: read ALL captures and sweeps with hardcoded roots) are done or accept --snapshot-root/--sweep-root; add the rules back from RETENTION.md afterwards.
